messages:
Alex: Heads-up — sampled debug logs from the canary are showing raw user emails in request bodies.
Maria: Wait, we already run prefix-scrub, how did emails get through? :eyes: 
Alex: It looks like the sampler is firing before the scrub step for a subset of routes (batching path). logs show sampler decision logged at `relay.sampler.v=1` then payload forwarded.
Dilip: That's the `relay->sampler` ordering bug we saw last quarter. Sampling happens pre-scrub when `batch_mode=true` unless you opt into `post_scrub_sampling`.
Samira: If true we should toggle per-route `post_scrub_sampling=true` in the console for the canary routes. Quick UX: expose a toggle labeled "sample after redaction (safer)".
Alex: For immediate mitigation I want to reduce the sample rate on the chat-bubble route and flip redaction to strict. Minimal change to rollout.
Maria: Low sample rate helps but hurts debugging. Can we add an owner-only temporary inspect that doesn't expose raw emails to SREs? Maybe a masked-preview instead.
Samira: Console idea: add a `preview-scrub` action that shows a pseudonymized snippet (hash partially masked), TTL 1 hour, audit logged. Owners + security review.
Dilip: Implementation note: preview requires persisting ephemeral masked payloads for later audit. That adds ~2ms per request and some storage cost — is that acceptable for canary?
Alex: For now I'll target config change. Proposed sampler payload update: 
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat/bubble",
  "sample_rate": 0.001,
  "post_scrub_sampling": true,
  "redact_level": "strict"
}
```
Maria: Nice. Also add a guard: `if (env === 'prod' && canary === true) { rate = min(rate, 0.001) }` so we don't accidentally spike.
Samira: UX checklist: expose toggle, add tooltip "post-scrub sampling avoids PII in stored samples", show expected sample count in last 24h, and an audit link.
Dilip: Can we implement the guard in the routing layer? Router already knows `route.metadata.canary` so it's straightforward.
Alex: I'll open a tiny PR to the sampler config store, and a follow-up ticket to add the console toggle + preview design.
Maria: Assign me for the console copy and audit log spec.
Samira: I'll mock the toggle in Figma, small tooltip and a red warning when owners enable inspect.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary sampler config change deployed to staging at 2024-11-14T18:09:05Z :rocket:
Alex: Thanks — can we monitor for any leak replays? Add a temporary alert on sampled payloads containing `@` and non-hashed emails.
Dilip: Adding alert: `telemetry.sampled.pii_detected > 0` -> page on-call and mute to slack #incidents only.
Maria: I'll coordinate with security to do a quick audit of persisted samples this week.
Alex: Great. Follow-ups: PR #3487 (sampler guard), ticket INF-912 (console toggle + preview), and a 1hr post-deploy review tomorrow.
Samira: Figma link: https://figma.com/s/preview-scrub (mock).
Maria: Thx all.
